description: Expose bounded low-cardinality runtime signals, tri-state OTel status, ranked route amplification, and truthful project-scoped agent-path work counts without making diagnostics business state or feeding the built-in collector back into itself.

tasks.title: Build the runtime observability publication core
tasks.description: Create RuntimeEpoch and RuntimeObservability as the process-local publication authority for the fixed Meter catalog, source-owned degradation, telemetry counters, transition logs, and immutable snapshots. Deliver typed collector/process/storage/ingest/request/path fact contracts without integrating ingestion, HTTP status, sampling, request middleware, or route retention yet.
acceptanceCriteria: RuntimeObservability exposes source-owned collector, process, storage, ingest, request and path fact methods; no public generic source setter exists and one producer cannot clear another source.
CompleteRequest and RecordAgentPath implement and directly contract-test normalized Meter publication; later request and agent tasks only invoke these established methods.
The exact Mohist.Server.Runtime names, kinds, units, attribute keys and bounded values are locked by MeterListener tests; no metrics exporter targets the built-in receiver.

IngestOutcome cannot be constructed from four independent aggregates; its builder accepts complete classified batch totals plus exactly one typed write result (not_attempted, committed, rolled_back or cancelled) and derives response disposition, received/saved/rejected/dropped and source changes.

Five-minute protection expiry, repeated-loss extension, stable reason codes/default messages, 256-character truncation, deterministic latest-reason ordering and transition-only logs use FakeTimeProvider and overlap tests.
RuntimeEpoch is reusable across host containers and snapshot reads perform no database, filesystem, HTTP or grain work.
Focused unit tests and repository npm test pass without external backend, host filesystem, network, process or wall-clock waits.
tasks.output: RuntimeEpoch, RuntimeObservability, fixed Meter catalog, typed outcome/publication contracts, source-isolation state machine and deterministic unit tests.
tasks.notes: Preparatory abstraction boundary directly usable through MeterListener, typed fact publication and immutable snapshots. Concrete producers and user surfaces are separate consumers.

tasks.title: Integrate telemetry outcome accounting
tasks.description: Refactor TraceIngester to classify a complete materialized request before writing and publish one derived IngestOutcome per batch. Add a typed accept-all-by-default protection decision boundary and one content-type-aware OTLP response writer so fake protection exercises rejection and partial success without introducing real admission policy or an ad hoc wire contract.
acceptanceCriteria: TraceIngester creates one immutable PreparedIngestBatch before opening the transaction; every identifiable Span attempt is classified as parsed-for-write, malformed dropped, protection rejected or another non-retryable drop.
IIngestProtectionDecision defaults to accepting all attempts in production; tests inject deterministic reject decisions and #437/#471 remain owners of real policy.

Exactly one IngestOutcome is recorded per materialized batch, with counters counting Span attempts; duplicate commit, malformed drop, fake rejection, retryable storage rollback and request cancellation match the spec and never double-publish a write result.

Only a production ingestion transaction that commits clears storage_write/storage_unverified; not-attempted empty, rejected, dropped, parse-failed or cancelled requests do not establish write readiness, and a storage-failure rollback publishes saved/rejected/dropped=0 plus only storage_write failure.

OtlpTraceResponseWriter chooses response encoding from the recognized request Content-Type, not Accept: JSON full success is 200 application/json `{}`, while protobuf full success is 200 application/x-protobuf with the zero-byte default ExportTraceServiceResponse.

Fake rejection/drop returns HTTP 200 ExportTraceServiceResponse.partial_success in the request encoding, with rejected_spans equal to rejected+dropped and a bounded message; JSON uses canonical protobuf-JSON names/string int64 and protobuf uses standard field numbers.

Malformed JSON and malformed/truncated protobuf return HTTP 400 google.rpc.Status code 3 in their request encoding without publishing an outcome; retryable storage-failure rollback returns HTTP 503 Status code 14, unsupported media returns 415 JSON Status, and wire-level tests decode every encoded response category.

For a mixed batch whose accepted subset rolls back, retryable failure takes precedence over provisional rejection/drop: JSON and protobuf wire tests assert HTTP 503 Status code 14, counter tests assert only parsed received attempts plus storage_write degradation, and repeated rollback attempts never add rejected/dropped or refresh ingest protection.

A signal-controlled transaction test cancels the request token only after begin: TraceIngester records one cancelled outcome, counts parsed received attempts only, leaves storage_write and ingest_protection unchanged (including an existing write failure), emits no OTLP response, and rethrows the original cancellation without wall-clock waits.
JSON and protobuf paths map the same outcome categories without a production rejection policy.
Focused ingester/OTLP/status-publication tests and repository npm test pass using in-memory SQLite and fake decisions.
tasks.output: Prepared ingest classification, fakeable protection decision, outcome publication, content-type-specific OTLP response encoding and focused wire tests.
tasks.notes: Implements the publication consumer and response mapping, not admission limits, retention or a real rejection producer.

tasks.title: Deliver complete tri-state status and diagnostics
tasks.description: Replace count-based status with the fixed API/CLI contract, non-initializing storage probe, sole process/storage sampler, and normal collector publication as one usable status module. The delivered production state supports off, healthy and degraded without waiting for another task.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /otel/api/status maps complete snake-case snapshots; JsonIgnoreCondition.Never preserves nullable sampled fields/latest_degradation, since uses RuntimeEpoch, collector_online projection is truthful, budget remains visible off, and legacy counts are absent.
TraceQuerier performs no status assembly or Trace/Span COUNT(*); historical telemetry/reasons do not change dependency calls, inspected records or response bounds.

OtelDb.OpenReadinessConnection uses Default Timeout=1 without EnsureInitialized/_initGate; the metadata-only probe runs one PRAGMA schema_version and reads nullable database/WAL/SHM lengths once each with no host-storage tests or synthetic writes.

StartAsync publishes one process result before availability and no storage; the fakeable sample includes CPU time, working set, heap and processor count. The loop races ApplicationStarted with stopping cancellation and stop-before-started performs zero storage calls.

After ApplicationStarted an enabled host performs one immediate storage probe; each injected 10-second tick samples process in both states and storage only enabled, with isolated exceptions, coalesced ticks and no overlap.

Process failure atomically nulls CPU/working-set/heap and resets CPU baseline; storage failure nulls usage/growth/window and clears growth samples. Recovery clears only its source and starts fresh warm-up while unrelated degradation remains.
CPU clamping/first-sample null, seven-slot/60-second growth/actual window, fixed budget, off no-measurement and observable-gauge omission match specs.

After successful normal primary StartAsync, Program publishes CollectorResult.Online; a successful metadata probe alone leaves enabled production degraded with storage_unverified, and only the first committed production ingestion write permits healthy.

mo otel status renders all sections and handles old/invalid/unreachable payloads; raw-null, off, healthy, independent failures/recovery, startup/stopping, no-scan/history and /api/health tests pass, followed by npm test.
tasks.output: Production-complete status DTO/API/CLI, readiness probe/filesystem seam, sole sampler, resource gauges/calculations, normal collector publication and deterministic tests.
tasks.notes: One complete vertical status slice: no temporary initializer or permanently unverified intermediate production status. Filesystem calls have no wall-clock guarantee and are never abandoned.

tasks.title: Install request-local work accounting
tasks.description: Deliver RequestWorkScope, TimeProvider-driven middleware, and EF/Orleans/HttpClient counting adapters as an independently usable request-accounting module. Keep agent response scopes active while OTel is off, but invoke T-001 Meter publication only while enabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Middleware creates scope exactly when OTel is enabled outside /otel/v1 and /otel/api, or for canonical/compatibility agent status/activity; CompleteRequest runs only enabled.

Middleware injects TimeProvider, brackets the awaited endpoint delegate with GetTimestamp/GetElapsedTime, and closes/publishes once in finally for normal, exceptional and cancelled completion without replacing the original exception; unavailable status normalizes to 0.
RequestWorkScope provides additive database/downstream and agent-path APIs; Snapshot is non-terminal and CloseAndSnapshot is linearizable with post-close no-op increments.
Business EF commands, caller-side Orleans invocations and physical HTTP sends/retries count once; incoming Orleans turns clear/restore scope and an in-process chain proves no transitive leakage.
The outermost HTTP builder filter invokes remaining filters first and appends counting last outside PrimaryHandler; retry-order tests prove one count per physical attempt.
The EF interceptor is installed in MohistServiceRegistration, MohistIntegrationFixture and GrainTestConfig only; dedicated tests construct options explicitly and unrelated factories remain unchanged.
OTel endpoints create no request scope, direct otel.db is excluded, and off agent scopes retain local counters but emit no Meter/route observation.

FakeTimeProvider tests advance deterministic duration for success, exception and cancellation without wall-clock waits or tolerance assertions; adapter, parallel, close, snapshot, Orleans-chain, retry, normalization and off-state tests pass, followed by npm test.
tasks.output: RequestWorkScope and TimeProvider-driven middleware, EF/Orleans/HTTP adapters, named composition-root wiring and deterministic accounting/duration tests.
tasks.notes: Consumes T-001 publication contracts. Detached launchers and complete trace feedback isolation belong to T-005.

tasks.title: Isolate detached and observability work
tasks.description: Introduce the scope-suppressing background launcher and complete trace/runtime suppression around OTel ingest, query, status, sampling and maintenance. Integrate against the concrete status/sampler and request-scope modules.
acceptanceCriteria: IBackgroundTaskLauncher replaces direct Task.Run in SystemUpdateService and BackgroundHermesIssueNotificationDispatcher, clears only RequestWorkScope while queueing, and provides awaitable fake signals.
Tests separately prove production launcher suppression, terminal snapshot immutability and both service migrations without scheduler waits.

OtelSuppressionMiddleware retains the /otel ASP.NET filter and enters SuppressInstrumentationScope.Begin around the awaited /otel/v1 and /otel/api endpoint delegate; disposal is guaranteed in failure/cancellation paths.

The sampler enters the same scope around each storage probe and registered OTel maintenance callback, while process reads/publication remain outside; suppression does not alter results or degradation publication.

Existing exporter URI filtering remains defense in depth; OTel endpoint/probe/maintenance work emits no equivalent ASP.NET/EF/Orleans/HttpClient trace or runtime measurement to the built-in collector.
Repeated self-processing terminates and normal non-OTel tracing/accounting remains unchanged; focused launcher/filter/sampler feedback tests and npm test pass.
tasks.output: Background launcher migrations, OtelSuppressionMiddleware, sampler/maintenance suppression, extended filters and feedback-loop tests.
tasks.notes: Owns the concrete `SuppressInstrumentationScope` integration; T-004 owns only request accounting.

tasks.title: Expose the bounded ranked route summary
tasks.description: Add the half-open five-minute route ring over T-004 observations and expose deterministic top rows through the complete status API and CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: The ring uses 301 half-open one-second buckets with 256 named routes plus other; overflow contributes to other and retained aggregate count is fixed.
Snapshot predicate is bucketEnd > now-5m and bucketStart <= now; fake-time tests cover fractional/integral boundaries before, at and after five minutes and five minutes plus one second.
GetSnapshot copies fixed route state under the established lock, releases it, then merges/ranks so request publication is not blocked by sorting.
Amplification is database plus downstream calls/request; order is amplification descending, average latency descending, route ordinal ascending with deterministic ties.
Status/CLI expose at most 10 exact fields, off retains none, restart starts empty and no external/history dependency is read.
Overflow, memory, expiry, ranking, restart, raw-route exclusion and status/CLI parity tests pass, followed by npm test.
tasks.output: Bounded route ring, short-lock snapshot copy, deterministic ranking, status/CLI rows and fake-time/cardinality tests.
tasks.notes: The anomalous-route view is threshold-free ranking, not alerting.

tasks.title: Preserve degraded status through bind fallback
tasks.description: Move startup orchestration into MohistHostRunner and transfer RuntimeEpoch/collector failure into a clean alternate host. Preserve database migration/data-upgrade initialization before every start attempt, drive primary and alternate production construction through one immutable host plan and Build(plan) path, stop/dispose before rebuilding, preserve enabled intent, and prevent failed startup from probing storage.
acceptanceCriteria: MohistHostRunner accepts IMohistHostFactory, IOtelBindFailureClassifier and IMohistDatabaseInitializer; the classifier receives only the collector listener intent with BindHost/Port, never the outbound exporter Endpoint; IMohistHost exposes Services, StartAsync, StopAsync, DisposeAsync and WaitForShutdownAsync, with WebApplication and signal-controlled fake adapters.

Production composition passes MohistDatabaseInitializer to the runner; DatabaseInitializationSpecs and DatabaseInitializerRepositoryUpgradeSpecs invoke that concrete dependency and together prove EF migration followed by the repository data upgrade.

Primary/alternate factories receive the same epoch; both use one production Build(plan) path, normal startup publishes collector online, and alternate RuntimeObservability is constructed with the explicit ordered seed list [storage_unverified, collector_bind_failed] before StartAsync so collector_bind_failed holds the strictly highest sequence.

Runner tests prove the fake initializer receives each primary/alternate host's Services exactly once before StartAsync; initialization failure prevents that host's start, is terminal rather than bind-classified, and always disposes the unstarted host, with no alternate after primary failure and ordered initialization/disposal errors.

Classified failure awaits StopAsync and always attempts DisposeAsync; alternate builds only after both succeed. Single failure is rethrown and dual failure is AggregateException in stop/dispose order.
Sampler waiting for ApplicationStarted exits on stopping cancellation, so failed-primary stop completes with zero storage probes.

Alternate host plan differs only by omitted OTLP listener intent and collector_bind_failed, preserves Enabled and common application composition, and its initial fake-host snapshot reports degraded with collector_online=false and latest_degradation.code == collector_bind_failed; the collector source remains active, while a later process/storage/protection failure becomes latest_degradation under the common sequence rule.

Fake runner tests cover primary/alternate initialization, generic/classified start, stop, dispose and dual failures, at most one remaining started host, zero primary probes and one alternate immediate probe without ports; they assert lifecycle/status projection only and make no HTTP-health or production-silo claim.
Classifier tests use different collector BindHost/Port and outbound exporter Endpoint values and prove only the listener intent controls bind-failure matching.

A non-starting production composition test compares immutable plans and service descriptors for shared Orleans/API markers and exactly one sampler registration per plan; it never builds a host, invokes database initialization, starts a host, resolves physical adapters, opens sockets or asserts runtime probe/silo facts; focused tests and npm test pass.
tasks.output: MohistHostRunner and lifecycle interfaces/adapters, preserved database initialization, immutable production host plan, one shared Build(plan) path, exception-safe fallback and responsibility-split host/factory tests.
tasks.notes: Any failed-host shutdown error is terminal; disposal is still attempted to preserve evidence.

tasks.title: Expose agent status and activity amplification
tasks.description: Extract shared project-resolved status/activity handlers, add exact amplification objects, and restore literal project-selector aliases. Use T-004's response-local snapshot in both states and invoke established path publication only enabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical routes/aliases call the same handlers; aliases trim values, select first nonblank projectId then X-Mohist-Project, accept resolver IDs/names, return 400 absent and give query precedence.
Middleware opens scope before either project resolution, so resolution database work is counted consistently and aliases never aggregate projects.
Every response contains exactly candidates, processed, transcriptRecords, databaseCalls and downstreamCalls with spec meanings/boundaries.
Status transcript is zero; activity additively counts every transcript materialization including repeats and snapshots after all awaited work.
Off returns truthful local counts without publication; enabled calls T-001 RecordAgentPath using only agent.status/activity and no identity/business effects.
API/AgentOps/Session tests cover empty/filter/reconciliation/transcripts/200 limit/history/off-enabled/parity and all selector edge cases; focused tests and npm test pass without #467/#468.
tasks.output: Shared agent handlers, amplification DTO/scope updates, project-selector aliases, enabled path publication and bounded operation-count tests.
tasks.notes: Expose current amplification only; #467/#468 later reduce work while retaining field meanings.
